{{Top|leg}}
The '''Queen of the Black''' was a title that was held by one of the three [[Quesoth]] [[Queen/Legends|Queens]], the rulers of the Quesoth [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Quesoth underwent a cycle whereby the Queen of the Black would reign from the [[White City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]] for a number of years until her [[Death/Legends|death]]. She would then be replaced by the [[Queen of the Red]] and on the Queen of the Red's death, the [[Queen of the White]] would emerge. The Queen of the White would then, in turn, be replaced by the Queen of the Black, and the process would repeat itself.
